verdict.rationale: Session replay is a fair question for a web/app analytics product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents GA4 recording or replaying user sessions, or masking sensitive input. The pack covers reporting APIs, the Admin API, Measurement Protocol, BigQuery export and an MCP server, none of which is session replay.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default
